chapter: Trent's band: touring, sidemen and breakup
title: Peanuts leaves; Bobby Booker, Alex Hill and Jimmy Sherman
summary: Peanuts probably quit; Bobby Booker came late at the Showboat; Alex Hill never played with them; Sherman found in Buffalo when Trent was ill.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: In Buffalo. Now there was a time when Peanuts left the band and came back, apparently. Did Peanuts quit the band or get fired or something? It wouldn't show on the records.
No, I don't think that he got fired; he must have quit.
He might have quit.
He was too powerful for anybody to fire him.
It seemed to me that you had a thing there--I know Bobby Booker was in the band at one point.
That was way later.
This is later?
This is way, way later.
We were just etting ready to break up.
Oh, when Bobby--
When Bobby Booker was in the band. That was in Massachusetts, and New York; we played the Showboat there. He was with us there.
That's when you had Alex Hill; that's the only time Alex Hill worked with the band. You knew Alex Hill in Little Rock?
Yes.
But you never played with him?
Never played with him.
Jimmy Sherman you got up in Buffalo too?
Right.
This must have been one of the first times that Trent left the band.
Trent got sick.
Oh, he got sick.
(Inaudible). Jimmy was so good that we kept him.
